post.summary: Replace an existing proposal's contents with a JSON file
post.description:
Reimports a proposal by replacing the slices the caller opts into
(pricing data, page content, design settings, proposal settings)
with the supplied JSON. CRM linkage, signatures, payments,
status, and history are always preserved.

The lifecycle is gated: only DRAFT, SENT, or template proposals can
be reimported, and only if no signatures or successful payments are
attached.

overwrite.description:
Per-slice overwrite flags. Each independently gates
replacement of one editorial slice. Omit (or send all
`true`) for legacy "replace everything" behavior.

409.description: Proposal not in a reimportable state

post.description: Star a proposal for the current user. Starred proposals appear first in listings. This operation is idempotent - starring an already-starred proposal has no effect.
